text:
maria.marketing: Heads up — planning a 3-part "Community Code Labs" series for April. Goal: hands-on tutorials + a small reference app repo + one live workshop. Want to align messaging, benchmark narrative for the refapp, and inbound lead routing. Thoughts?
jamal.devrel: love it. proposed topics: 1) quickstart (hosted API example), 2) cost/perf tuning (batching + quant), 3) production checklist (rollouts + metrics). each with a 20–30 min code walk.
sophia.content: i'll draft short copy for each tutorial. can we name the repo `community-code-labs` and include a tiny node + python demo? keeps it easy for folks to clone.
alex.growth: routing question — webinar signups and repo stars should create leads in HubSpot with source=community-labs. can ops add a lifecycle mapping and a tag for "dev-signal"?
chris.ops: yes, we can add a mapping. proposed routing snippet for the event webhook:
```
{
  "source": "community-code-labs",
  "destination": "hubspot",
  "tags": ["community-labs","dev-signal"],
  "assign_to_team": "growth-se"
}
```
jamal.devrel: benchmark narrative idea: show 3 configs (baseline FP16, quantized int8, and cached-batched) and surface cost/latency tradeoffs in one chart. keep prompts simple and reproducible.
sophia.content: short blog post outline: hook -> what you'll build -> benchmark highlights -> quick deploy -> call-to-action (star repo + sign up for workshop). i can get first draft by Thu.
maria.marketing: assign: sophia = blog + workshop script, jamal = refapp + benchmark harness, alex = lead routing & CTAs, chris = infra hooks + preview deploys. deadine: next Wed (1779460200).
devrel-bot: preview site built: https://preview.redwood.dev/community-code-labs (staging) — preview deploy id: preview-cc-labs-42 :rocket:
jamal.devrel: will push minimal harness to `community-code-labs` today. will include a `benchmarks/` folder and `run_bench.sh`.
chris.ops: i'll wire the webhook and add a test event. when done i'll post a test lead with tag `dev-signal`.
alex.growth: CTA copy suggestion: "Build with Redwood Inference — follow the Code Labs & get a free credit to try your refapp." short UTM: ?utm_source=community&utm_campaign=code_labs
sophia.content: noted. i'll include the CTA and UTM in the blog and tutorial READMEs.
maria.marketing: perfect. check-in Tuesday standup, otherwise ping here for blockers. thanks everyone :pray:
